_about: FIBO 2.0 VGL template for a home-page hero (owner S7). Copy structured_prompt, write every per_image field, keep every fixed field verbatim, and send only structured_prompt to the node. Rules: art/DIRECTION.md, 'Prompts: FIBO 2.0 in VGL'.
route: Comfy Cloud Bria node api_bria_fibo2_t2i; allowed only after Comfy's written confirmation (art/LICENSES.md)

node.seed: {an integer of 1 or more; record it with the render}
node.source: get_node on Comfy Cloud, 2026-11-02, recorded in baseline/v2/art-DIRECTION.md (Sizes on the Bria node). Ratios wider than 16:9 render at 1MP only.

keepers: To show a keeper, add one objects entry pasted verbatim from art/keepers/<id>.yaml objects_entry, then write its location and relationship. At most 5 objects in all (VGL guide).

structured_prompt.short_description: {the scene in one or two sentences: founders building together in the Hall, with a real Colorado view through it}

objects.description: {a small group of human founders of mixed ages and backgrounds in casual Colorado clothes, building something together with laptops, sketches and a prototype}
objects.location: {where in the frame, outside the calm upper-left third}
objects.relationship: {the focal point of the picture, and how the other objects relate to it}

structured_prompt.background_setting: {the carved hall and the one real Colorado view through its arch or doors, as it is; see art/DIRECTION.md, Inside the doors and Real places}

lighting.conditions: luminous golden light from a low warm sun, glowing lanterns and contained forge fire, with a soft warm underglow from molten-gold channels in the floor
lighting.direction: {where the warm key light comes from: the low sun through the arch, a hearth or lanterns}

aesthetics.composition: wide establishing shot built from two or three large, chunky shapes, with the founders as the focal point and a calm, open, bright, low-detail area across the upper-left third
aesthetics.color_scheme: warm cream and honey gold with ember orange, copper and hammered bronze, gold inlaid in cool pink-grey granite, and one clear note of Colorado sky blue

photographic_characteristics.focus: sharp focus on the founders, with a painted, detailed background

structured_prompt.style_medium: stylized hand-painted high-fantasy illustration with a few bold, chunky shapes, sturdy exaggerated proportions, thick confident outlines, visible painted brush texture and soft cel shading
structured_prompt.context: a wide, full-bleed hero illustration for the top of a community's home page, running edge to edge with no border or frame
